name: Bard Ring Dancer
body:
Ring dancer bards are masters of performing with their dancing rings, both to inspire allies and defeat opponents in battle. They incorporate beautiful patterns and coloration in their use of the weapon to dazzle and amaze.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Ring dancers are proficient with all simple weapons, dancing rings, and whips (including scorpion whips). They are proficient with bucklers, but not other shields.

This alters the bard’s weapon and shield proficiencies.

Immortal (Su)

When a ring dancer first becomes attuned to their dancing rings (see symphonic weapon), he also becomes immortal. He ceases to age naturally and cannot die of old age unless separated from his dancing rings for longer than one week per bard level.

Symphonic Weapon (Ex)

At 1st level, a ring dancer receives dancing rings that he wears as part of his outfit. These dancing rings may be inherited from a family member, discovered before the bard set out to adventure, or otherwise obtained as part of becoming a ring dancer. These dancing rings are specially attuned to the ring dancer and only function for him. If stolen, they are worth only 4d10 gp.

A ring dancer’s dancing rings can be used as part of making the following Perform checks: dance, percussion, and wind. The ring dancer adds the weapon’s enhancement bonus on those Perform checks and any versatile performance skill checks associated with them, such as Acrobatics and Fly for Perform (dance).

Ring Striker (Su)

As a standard action, a ring dancer can make an attack with his dancing rings and begin a bardic performance using them as part of the same action. This includes special actions, such as Vital Strike. Doing this costs 1 additional round of bardic performance.

Beginning at 13th level, the ring dancer can make an attack with his dancing rings as an attack action and begin a bardic performance using them as part of the same action. This includes special attacks, such as when charging or using Spring Attack.

This ability replaces countersong.

Deadly Rings (Su)

At 20th level, when a ring dancer threatens a critical hit with his dancing rings while using bardic performance, he can spend 2 rounds of bardic performance to automatically confirm the critical hit and have the ring’s damage multiplier increased by 1 (x4 becomes x5, for example). In addition, he cannot be disarmed while wielding dancing rings.

This ability replaces deadly performance.
